fields.value: CAD 7,293.60 tuition for a Canadian student, Bachelor of Arts, Fall 2026/Winter 2027 (UAlberta cost calculator, standard first-year load). Course-based, so it changes with the courses taken. Living cost: same estimate as for international students, for a student living away from home.
University of Alberta Registrar, non-instructional fees 2026-27 (on campus, full-time): CAD 1,494.07/term minus opt-out SU health (204.93) and dental (199.84) plans = CAD 1,089.30/term × 2.

living_cost_source_basis.description: No official program living-cost estimate captured this pass; not fabricated.
